criteria.criteria_note: Written before the first DoltHub SQL request made by this task (the 2026-09-29 16:1x probe by the gap-search agent is the only earlier contact). Thresholds are copied verbatim from queue T-20260929-60 plan item 4; the operational definitions below only fix ambiguities and were chosen before any data was pulled.
criteria.verbatim_queue_text: 通过标准（先写死）：SPY、QQQ、AAPL、NVDA、TSLA 五个标的的日覆盖率 2019 起 ≥ 85%、2024 起 ≥ 90%；平价反推的标的价格与 SIP 收盘价（或开盘价，取更近者）中位相对偏差 ≤ 0.10%；SPY、QQQ 近月 ATM 相对价差中位数 ≤ 3%、个股 ≤ 10%；坏报价占比 ≤ 2%。**结论只有三档**：通过（解锁 T-61/62/63，成交口径写明"用哪天的快照近似次日成交"）；部分通过（只允许覆盖率达标的标的，其它任务只能用这个标的清单，写进 T-61/62/63 的 notes）；不通过（把 T-61/62/63 改 blocked，T-64 由 blocked 改 ready 并通知机主）。
criteria.verbatim_test_list: (a) 交易日覆盖率 = 有数据的日期 ÷ data/sip/daily 该标的的交易日；(b) 时间点：用 put-call 平价 C-P = S-K 从近月 ATM 的买卖中间价反推标的价格，和 SIP 日线当日收盘价、次日开盘价比较，判断快照更接近哪一个；(c) 相对价差 (ask-bid)/mid：近月 ATM 与 25 delta 合约，按标的、年份的分位数（SPY/QQQ 与个股分开），和已发表的"ATM 跨式价差约占权利金 5-15%"对照；(d) iv_current 日自相关（应 > 0.9）、与链里 ATM 合约 vol 的一致性；(e) 缺口是否随机：缺失日和当日 |收益| 的关系；(f) 每个标的每天的合约数、到期日数随年份的变化（2019-2022 对 2024 起）；(g) 有没有零买价、买价大于卖价、卖价<买价、明显过期的报价占比。

operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.coverage: per symbol: (# SIP daily sessions of that symbol on which option_chain has >=1 row) / (# SIP daily sessions of that symbol), pooled over 2019-02-09..last date ('since 2019') and 2024-01-02..last date ('since 2024'); also reported per year. Sessions before 2019-02-09 are excluded from the denominator.
operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.parity: per symbol-day, expiry = the shortest expiry with calendar DTE >= 3 (avoids expiry-day artefacts and keeps the carry term K*r*T small); strike = the strike with the smallest |call_mid - put_mid| among strikes with both call and put quotes having bid>0; S_hat = call_mid - put_mid + K (literal C-P=S-K; no rate/dividend adjustment; the resulting carry bias is reported, not corrected). deviation = |S_hat / ref - 1| against ref in {SIP close of day d, SIP open of next session d+1}; per symbol the 'closer' reference is the one with the lower pooled median deviation (also reported: d+1 close, d-1 close). Criterion: that median <= 0.10% for the symbol (whole sample). A second diagnostic uses expiry DTE>=25 and is not a criterion.
operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.spread: per symbol-day, near-month = the shortest expiry with calendar DTE >= 7; ATM contract pair = the strike whose call delta is closest to 0.50 among strikes with both legs quoted bid>0 and ask>bid; rel spread = mean over the call and put at that strike of (ask-bid)/((ask+bid)/2). 25-delta: same expiry, put with delta closest to -0.25 and call closest to +0.25, both with bid>0. Criterion is on the pooled median over all symbol-days of the ATM metric, and must hold BOTH over the full sample and over 2024-01-02 onward (stricter reading chosen up-front).
operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.bad_quotes: denominator = rows with 0.10 <= |delta| <= 0.90 (the tradeable band; far-OTM zero bids are natural and are excluded from the criterion but reported over all rows). A row is bad if any of: bid or ask NULL; bid < 0; ask <= 0; ask < bid (crossed); bid = 0 while ask > 0 within the band (zero bid inside the band); or stale: mid is more than 1% of the reference underlying close below the intrinsic value for the leg. Criterion: bad share <= 2% for the symbol over the full sample.
operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.iv_consistency: diagnostic only: lag-1 autocorrelation of volatility_history.iv_current per symbol (expected > 0.9) and median |iv_current - vol of the delta~0.5 near-month call| / iv_current.
operational_definitions_fixed_before_dat.gap_randomness: diagnostic only: mean |close-to-close return| on missing vs present days; a missing-day mean more than 1.25x the present-day mean is flagged as non-random.

verdict_rule_fixed_before_data.pass: all five acceptance symbols meet every criterion (coverage both windows, parity, spread, bad quotes).
verdict_rule_fixed_before_data.partial: at least one symbol meets every criterion but not all five; the allowed list is exactly the symbols that meet every criterion (the seven extra symbols IWM, SMH, TQQQ, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META are judged by the same thresholds - 10% spread bound as single-name/ETF non-SPY/QQQ - only if they were fetched, and are then added to the allowed list on the same terms).
verdict_rule_fixed_before_data.fail: no acceptance symbol meets every criterion.
verdict_rule_fixed_before_data.incomplete: if the five acceptance symbols are not all fetched within the 90-minute task window, the verdict is 'incomplete' and no pass is declared on partial data.

verdict.basis: Pre-registered rule: fail = no acceptance symbol meets every criterion. Coverage (exact, from server-side per-date aggregates over ALL 1,919 US sessions 2019-02-09..2026-09-28) is below 85% since 2019 and below 90% since 2024 for all five symbols (QQQ has no option_chain rows at all; TSLA starts 2021-01-04), so more chain data could not change the tier. The literal put-call parity criterion also fails on the fixed clean window (median 0.15%-0.40% vs 0.10%). The chain-level tests (parity, spread, stale) are on a seeded random sample of days plus the last 13 sessions, not the full chain; the 'incomplete' clause of the rule protects against false passes and is not what decides here.
verdict.unlocks: none under the frozen criteria; T-64 (paid data) goes to the owner. Coverage from 2024-09-04 onward is dense (SPY/AAPL/NVDA/TSLA 96-100% by month, post-hoc figure in per_symbol) and spread/bad-quote checks pass for those four, but 2020-01..2024-08 has only about 58% of sessions (about 3 of 5 weekdays), 2019 has none before 2019-05-10, and QQQ, IWM, SMH, TQQQ are absent; using the dense window would be a NEW post-hoc contract for the coordinator/owner, not a pass.
verdict.snapshot_time: Put-call parity on 2026-09-10..09-28 (13 sessions, 4 symbols, series in tables.parity_b.*.recent_series): implied spot vs SIP close of day d is typically +0.1%..+0.2% (carry bias of the literal formula at 11-16 DTE); vs next open d+1 the errors are +-1%..+3%. The snapshot is the close of day d (end-of-day quotes). SIP daily bars are adjustment=all (dividends) so older dates cannot be compared to raw option prices; the parity criterion was judged only from 2026-09-22 (n=4-5 days per symbol).
verdict.execution_recommendation: Signal day d: treat DoltHub IV/quotes as close-of-d information. Fill an option order at the d+1 snapshot quotes (ask to buy, bid to sell) or, for stock trades signalled from IV, at d+1 open. Do not use d's snapshot quotes as fills for a signal computed from them.

cache.volatility_history_coverage: partial: symbol-restricted windows from 2019-02-09 to about 2020-08 only
cache.rate_limit: no HTTP 429 in any run; failures were server-side 'context deadline exceeded' on heavy queries (100-date aggregate batches, symbol-filtered date ranges) and one upstream 503; per-request latency 0.3-57 s (SELECT 1 took 47 s at 16:33 UTC, most runs 2-5 s after 17:20).

verdict.other_symbols_probe: IWM, SMH, TQQQ, QQQ have no option_chain rows on 2026-09-28; on 2025-06-02 and 2022-06-01 IWM, SMH, TQQQ, QQQ were also absent while MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META (and XLF) were present (probe queries, not full coverage). volatility_history on 2026-09-28: SPY present, QQQ/IWM/SMH/TQQQ absent. Extra symbols were not fully evaluated (not fetched).
